STRANGER THAN HEAVEN - Suzy Day (Portrayed by Tori Kelly) 'Mr. Bee' In-Game Performance
A talented singer who dreams of making it big. This is a song she creates together with Daito in postwar Atami, during a time when foreign cultures and people from overseas were beginning to flow into Japan and a new culture was taking shape.

STRANGER THAN HEAVEN launches January 15, 2027 on XBOX Game Pass, XBOX Series X|S, XBOX on PC, and XBOX Cloud.
